'''Xilxash''' was a small [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] known for its delicious [[brul]] fruit, which was all the rage in the finest [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscanti]] [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurants]]. In [[44 ABY]], Xilxash applied for and was granted [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] membership.

==History==
===Early history===
Xilxash was a small<ref name="FJ" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Yminis sector/Legends|Yminis sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> During the existence of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]], Xilxash was a backrocket world, notable largely for its [[Agriworld/Legends|agricultural]] contributions, particularly a succulent [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] called [[brul]], which was all the rage in the finest [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscanti]] [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurants]]. Nevertheless, the planet was not part of the Galactic Alliance because the government of Xilxash supported the practice of [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]], which did not meet the criteria for acceptance.<ref name="FJ" />

===Alliance membership===
{{Quote|Today we have fourteen different worlds applying for membership in the Galactic Alliance.|Wynn Dorvan, to his own office|<ref name="FJ" />}}
[[File:WynnDorvan-ERC.jpg|left|thumb|250px|Chief of State of the Galactic Alliance, Wynn Dorvan, was pleased to see slavery cease on so many worlds, including Xilxash]]
The political situation on Xilxash changed dramatically<ref name="FJ" /> in [[44 ABY]].<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> That [[Standard year/Legends|year]] was marked by a wave of revolutions across the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], which brought an end to slavery on numerous worlds. Some uprisings were extremely violent, while others resulted in relatively little loss of life or property damage, but all represented significant political upheavals. On Xilxash, the new government had toppled the old regime fairly easily, and most of the planet's current «masters» concluded that they would benefit more from having slaves as contributing citizens who could be taxed than from keeping them as property that cost money.<ref name="FJ" />

Less positive was the chaos that inevitably followed such a profound change. The newly established governments submitted many applications to the [[Galactic Alliance Senate]] from worlds that had previously been denied membership. Although such applications were largely the Senate's purview, [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Wynn Dorvan]] still had to be involved. [[Triumvirate (Galactic Alliance)|His office]] convened emergency meetings to consider applications from fourteen different worlds seeking Galactic Alliance membership. The consensus regarding Xilxash was reached fairly quickly: the planet's proposal contained nothing objectionable and offered much that was positive.<ref name="FJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
The planet Xilxash was first mentioned in the novel ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]'', which was written by [[Christie Golden]]<ref name="FJ" /> and released in [[2011]].<ref name="Amazon">{{RandomHouseOld|url=book/68770/star-wars-fate-of-the-jedi-ascension-by-christie-golden|text=Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi: Ascension}}</ref> Later, the [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|online appendix]] to the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the [[Xilxash system/Legends|Xilxash star system]] and the planet itself in grid square S-15.<ref name="EAOC" />
